messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx and TCP resets observed on inference-proxy-us-east between 02:04 UTC -> 02:08 UTC. Likely upstream provider degradation. see: https://console.redwood/prod/alerts/alertrun-2141594321
Ava P.: noticed client visible retries and streaming sessions cutting out. root spans show model request timeouts. paging oncall Rafael.
Rafael (oncall): joining. looking at provider telemetry now. Rafael (oncall): providerC shows sustained packet loss to gpu pool 3 (loss ~18%). RTTs spiking.
Telemetry Bot: providerC->gpu-node-east-3 packet_loss 0.18, retransmits +22%, backend-5xx-rate +210%
Ava P.: impact quick tally: Customer Ops reports 2 enterprise customers and a few mid-tier tenants affected; mostly streaming endpoints and long-context calls. Customer Ops: affected: VoyagerAI (enterprise), ShopGrid (enterprise), NoteFlow (mid).
Rafael (oncall): initial mitigation options: 1) immediate partial traffic reroute to providerD 2) targeted soft-concurrency quotas for noisy tenants 3) disable high-throughput non-essential features (context-injection, realtime-rerank) 4) partial drain of non-enterprise streaming routes on providerC. prefer combo 1+2+4.
Ava P.: agree. propose staged weight shift 0 -> 15 -> 35% to providerD, apply soft quotas to top noisy sessions, and drain streaming/* non-enterprise from providerC.
Maya S.: if we reroute, set model-variant compatibility fallback to avoid kernel mismatch. providerD uses different GPU family.
Rafael (oncall): prepared routing change. config to push: ```json
{"route":"inference-us-east","weights":{"providerC":0.65,"providerD":0.35},"comment":"mitigate providerC packet loss"}
``` rolling over 90s with health checks.
Ava P.: applying targeted soft quotas now for top offenders. commands: ```sh
redwood ctl quota set --tenant VoyagerAI --qps 10 --soft=true
redwood ctl quota set --tenant ShopGrid --qps 12 --soft=true
redwood ctl sessions limit --tenant NoteFlow --concurrency 3 --max-tokens-per-minute 1500
```
deploy-bot: executing runbook 'partial-provider-reroute' (rb-99). runbook steps: validate health, push route weights in waves, monitor 5xx and tail-latency, enable fallback variants. status: started.
Rafael (oncall): setting runtime model fallback to compat-family to avoid tokenization mismatch: ```sh
redwood ctl models set-fallback --route inference-us-east --fallback-family compat-small-v2
```
Ava P.: also toggling feature flags: disable non-enterprise context-injection and realtime-rerank: ```sh
redwood ctl feature toggle disable --flag context-injection --scope non_enterprise
redwood ctl feature toggle disable --flag realtime-rerank --scope non_enterprise
```
Ava P.: starting wave 1 -> set providerD weight to 15% now.
deploy-bot: roll task id=roll-2141 applying weights providerD=15% (wave 1/3).
Ava P.: after wave1: cluster 5xx from 3.1% -> 2.3%. p95 tail latency improved 260ms -> 240ms. streaming errors still concentrated on NoteFlow.
Customer Ops: notified VoyagerAI and ShopGrid. told them we're applying mitigations and will follow up with logs. ETA told: ~30-40m for stabilization.
Rafael (oncall): proceed wave2 -> increase providerD to 25%.
deploy-bot: roll task id=roll-2141 wave2 applied providerD=25% (wave 2/3).
Ava P.: after wave2: 5xx 1.9%, p95 210ms. NoteFlow still hitting concurrency limits and showing session retries.
Maya S.: initiating targeted session backpressure for NoteFlow: `redwood ctl sessions backpressure --tenant NoteFlow --reduce-rate 30% --max-concurrency 3`
Ava P.: enabling partial drain of non-enterprise streaming routes on providerC: runbook 'soft-drain-non-ep' step: label routes streaming/* with drain=true and attach low-priority scaling.
Rafael (oncall): applying drain: ```sh
redwood deploy route set --route-pattern streaming/* --provider providerC --drain=true --scope non_enterprise
```
Ava P.: rolling wave3 -> providerD to 35%. watching health.
deploy-bot: roll task id=roll-2141 wave3 applied providerD=35% (wave 3/3). final weights providerC=65% providerD=35%.
Ava P.: stabilization stats: overall 5xx down from 3.1% -> 0.8%, p95 from 260ms -> 160ms. VoyagerAI/ShopGrid error rates back to baseline. NoteFlow still elevated but serving with backpressure.
Customer Ops: provided per-tenant log links and confirmed VoyagerAI sees degraded sessions recovered. NoteFlow requested immediate more info; gave them session IDs and log link: https://console.redwood/customers/NoteFlow/sessions/5673
Maya S.: preparing handoff to night SRE. leaving a summary and actions taken. Maya S.: handing off to Ops Lead for post-incident coordination.
Ops Lead: noted. request quick RCA draft: suspected root cause providerC transient network congestion to gpu-node-east-3, exacerbated by KV cache churn from long-stream sessions. mitigation: staged provider reroute, soft tenant throttles, partial drain, disabled non-enterprise heavy features, fallback model family. next steps: post-mortem, evaluate providerC SLAs, add automated detection for long-KV churn patterns and auto-soft-throttle for high-session-token velocity.
Rafael (oncall): closing the active mitigation channel; monitoring for 15m before full close. will reopen if 5xx > 1% or p95 > 220ms.
incident-bot: incident annotated: mitigation actions rb-99 applied, participants: Rafael (oncall), Ava P., Maya S., deploy-bot. followup: schedule postmortem within 48h.
Ava P.: thanks team. leaving logs and metric slices in the incident folder: https://console.redwood/incidents/2141594321/notes
